units.source_scale_reason: Guides are the accepted paintings at their accepted scale; every video frame keeps one fixed extraction scale and anchor.

visual_review.notes: H3 video. The first idle and walk plates turn green partway through and the hit plate goes black, so all three were retaken. The single-reference idle retake raises the crossbow to full aim and looses a bolt, so the idle runs forward and back over its calm lowered stretch. The walk retake is clean and loops on its second cycle. The hit retake ends before a white flash. The attack skips the muzzle flash and the pink flare at the chest and snaps from mid-reach to full reach. The ranged jumps from sighting to the recoil so the bolt and its beam are never shown. The cast skips the flare at the raised bolt tip.
